screen.grandline.abilities.hint: Pick an ability, then click a slot. Right-click a slot to clear it.
screen.grandline.abilities.none: You have no abilities yet. Eat a Devil Fruit, train Haki or learn a fighting style. Creators can use /onepiece unlock all.
ability.grandline.soru.desc: Kick the ground dozens of times in an instant and vanish. Blink up to 8 blocks forward; attacks miss you for a moment.
ability.grandline.geppo.desc: Kick the air itself to jump again in mid-air. Up to 3 kicks before you must land. Cancels fall damage.
ability.grandline.tekkai.desc: Hold to harden your body like iron. Physical damage is cut to a quarter and knockback ignored, but you can barely move.
fruit.grandline.gum_gum.desc: Turns the body into rubber. Stretch to strike from afar, slingshot across the map, shrug off blunt blows and lightning, bounce off any fall. Awakens into Gear Fifth.
fruit.grandline.leopard.desc: A carnivorous Zoan. Become a towering leopard-man or a full leopard: claws that make wounds bleed, pounces, and a predator's speed. Awakens into a berserk hunter.
fruit.grandline.flame.desc: A Logia: your body is fire. Blows pass through you, fire cannot hurt you, and your flames burn everything they touch. Awakens to set the battlefield itself alight.
ability.grandline.fire_fist.desc: Hold to gather fire into your fist, release to hurl it as a huge burning projectile. A full charge is bigger and hits harder.
ability.grandline.fire_gun.desc: Finger guns: five fast fire bullets in a tight spread.
ability.grandline.flame_commandment.desc: Raise a wall of fire in front of you. It burns and pushes back anyone crossing it and burns arrows out of the air.
ability.grandline.fire_pillar.desc: Mark a spot; a moment later a column of fire erupts there, launching and burning everyone on it.
ability.grandline.flame_emperor.desc: Gather a small sun over your head while you stand still, then hurl it. Slow, costly and devastating.
ability.grandline.fireflies.desc: Awakened. Scatter glowing fireflies that drift to nearby enemies and cling to them.
ability.grandline.firefly_detonate.desc: Awakened. Ignite every firefly you placed; each bursts into a fire explosion.
ability.grandline.flame_field.desc: Awakened. The ground around you becomes a sea of flames, burning and slowing enemies while it lasts.
ability.grandline.gum_pistol.desc: A stretching punch that reaches 14 blocks. In Gear Second it becomes the faster Jet Pistol.
ability.grandline.gum_rocket.desc: Grab a far block with both arms and slingshot yourself to it.
ability.grandline.gum_gatling.desc: Hold for a storm of stretching punches in front of you.
ability.grandline.gum_bazooka.desc: Pull both arms back, release to slam both palms forward with huge knockback.
ability.grandline.gear_second.desc: Pump blood through your rubber veins: faster, stronger, steaming. Pistol becomes Jet Pistol.
ability.grandline.gum_giant_pistol.desc: Inflate your arm to giant size, then punch through everything in a line.
ability.grandline.gear_fifth.desc: Awakened. The rubber body becomes free: enemies near you bounce off the rubbery ground.
ability.grandline.gum_dawn_fist.desc: Awakened, Gear Fifth only. A fist the size of a house drops from the sky onto the target.
ability.grandline.leopard_hybrid.desc: Become a leopard-man: bigger, armoured, clawed and stronger.
ability.grandline.leopard_beast.desc: Become a full leopard: very fast, low to the ground, fits through one-block gaps.
ability.grandline.leopard_pounce.desc: Leap at your prey; the first enemy you hit is mauled and slowed. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.leopard_claws.desc: Three raking slashes in front of you that leave bleeding wounds. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.leopard_frenzy.desc: Hold to become a whirlwind of claws. Hybrid form only.
ability.grandline.leopard_primal_fury.de: Awakened. Berserk: rapid regeneration, toughness and strength while transformed.
ability.grandline.leopard_roar.desc: Awakened. A roar that knocks back and weakens everyone nearby.
ability.grandline.observation_haki.desc: Sense every living presence nearby, even through walls; enemies glow red. While active you may read and dodge attacks (12-40% chance by level, costs stamina).
ability.grandline.future_sight.desc: See a few seconds ahead: every attack aimed at you is dodged for a small stamina cost, and you see where enemies are about to move. Observation level 60.
ability.grandline.armament_haki.desc: Coat your arms in black Haki. Blows hit 25-50% harder and strike a Logia's true body.
ability.grandline.full_body_hardening.de: Harden your whole body: damage taken is cut by 30-45%, knockback mostly ignored, and every blow counts as Armament. Armament level 35.
ability.grandline.armament_emission.desc: Your next blow within 5 seconds sends Haki through the target, ignoring armour and blasting it back from inside. Needs an active coating. Armament level 70.
ability.grandline.conquerors_haki.desc: Hold to gather your will, release to unleash it. Weak-willed foes collapse, others are intimidated, and another king clashes with you. Charge longer for a wider wave.
ability.grandline.conquerors_infusion.de: Wrap your attacks in Conqueror's Haki: black lightning on every blow, much harder hits that hurl foes back and touch a Logia. Conqueror's level 60.
death.attack.grandline.dark: %1$s was swallowed by the darkness of %2$s
death.attack.grandline.dark.player: %1$s was swallowed by the darkness of %2$s
fruit.grandline.smoke.desc: Become smoke: drift, bind foes in white clouds and slip through every blow.
fruit.grandline.sand.desc: Become sand: desert blades, sandstorms and a touch that dries everything it grips.
fruit.grandline.rumble.desc: Become lightning: strike from the sky and move at the speed of thunder.
fruit.grandline.ice.desc: Become ice: freeze the ground, the sea and anyone you touch.
fruit.grandline.dark.desc: Command darkness: pull everything in, swallow attacks and nullify Devil Fruit powers.
fruit.grandline.glint.desc: Become light: kicks at light speed, rains of laser and instant travel.
fruit.grandline.magma.desc: Become magma: fists of molten rock that burn even fire.
fruit.grandline.swamp.desc: Become a bottomless swamp that swallows enemies and stores anything.
fruit.grandline.gas.desc: Become gas: poison clouds, explosive mixtures and air with no oxygen.
fruit.grandline.snow.desc: Become snow: blizzards, snow rabbits and a body that buries foes.
fruit.grandline.forest.desc: Become a forest: roots that drain life, vines that bind and trees that grow at will.
fruit.grandline.op.desc: Create a ROOM where you rearrange, slice and swap anything inside like a surgeon.
fruit.grandline.tremor.desc: Shake the very air and earth: quakes that crack the sky and topple islands.
fruit.grandline.string.desc: Make razor strings: slice, puppet foes, walk the clouds and cage a whole island.
fruit.grandline.mochi.desc: A special Paramecia: create, become and shape sticky mochi.
fruit.grandline.chop.desc: Split your body into floating pieces; blades cannot cut you.
fruit.grandline.slip.desc: A perfectly smooth body: attacks slide off and you slide anywhere.
fruit.grandline.bomb.desc: Make any part of your body (even your breath and snot) explode.
fruit.grandline.kilo.desc: Change your weight from one kilo to ten thousand: float, then crush.
fruit.grandline.flower.desc: Sprout copies of your limbs anywhere you can see: grab, clutch and build giant hands.
fruit.grandline.wax.desc: Make wax as hard as steel: armour, shackles and weapons.
fruit.grandline.munch.desc: Eat anything and become what you ate.
fruit.grandline.clone.desc: Take the face and body of anyone you have touched.
fruit.grandline.dice.desc: Turn your body into steel blades.
fruit.grandline.spike.desc: Grow spikes from anywhere on your body.
fruit.grandline.bind.desc: Anything that passes through your body is locked in iron bonds.
fruit.grandline.spring.desc: Turn your legs and arms into springs: rebound jumps and spring-loaded blows.
fruit.grandline.slow.desc: Fire Noro Noro beams that slow anything they touch for thirty seconds.
fruit.grandline.door.desc: Open doors in anything, even the air itself.
fruit.grandline.bubble.desc: Make soap bubbles that wash away strength and slipperiness.
fruit.grandline.berry.desc: Split into berry-like balls that scatter from any attack.
fruit.grandline.rust.desc: Rust any metal you touch until it crumbles.
fruit.grandline.wheel.desc: Turn your limbs into wheels and race along the ground.
fruit.grandline.revive.desc: Return to life once after death, with a soul that can leave the body and freeze foes.
fruit.grandline.shadow.desc: Control shadows: steal them, swap places with yours and send it to fight.
fruit.grandline.hollow.desc: Release ghosts: negative hollows drain the will to fight.
fruit.grandline.clear.desc: Become invisible, along with anything you touch.
fruit.grandline.paw.desc: Paw pads that repel anything: air, pain, fatigue, even people across the world.
fruit.grandline.love.desc: Turn anyone smitten by you to stone.
fruit.grandline.venom.desc: Make deadly poisons: venom hydras, poison clouds and a demon of venom.
fruit.grandline.hormone.desc: Inject hormones that heal, enrage, grow or change a body.
fruit.grandline.snip.desc: Turn your hands into scissors that cut anything like paper.
fruit.grandline.wash.desc: Wash people clean of evil and wring them dry like laundry.
fruit.grandline.float.desc: Make anything you have touched float, yourself included.
fruit.grandline.mark.desc: Mark a target: anything you throw will hunt it down.
fruit.grandline.arms.desc: Turn any part of your body into weapons: blades, guns, missiles.
fruit.grandline.spin.desc: Spin your limbs like propellers: fly and grind.
fruit.grandline.stick.desc: Secrete flammable mucus that glues anything in place.
fruit.grandline.ripple.desc: Make anything ripple like a flag: steel cloaks, flowing blades.
fruit.grandline.stone.desc: Merge with and command stone: walls, fists and a giant stone body.
fruit.grandline.stitch.desc: Sew anything together, even people to the ground.
fruit.grandline.glare.desc: See through everything and everyone, even into minds.
fruit.grandline.art.desc: Turn people and places into abstract art that cannot move properly.
fruit.grandline.jacket.desc: Become a jacket and take over whoever wears you.
fruit.grandline.pop.desc: Make your body and anything you touch swell and burst.
fruit.grandline.swim.desc: Swim through the ground and walls as if they were water.
fruit.grandline.hobby.desc: Turn anyone you touch into a toy bound to obey.
fruit.grandline.barrier.desc: Create unbreakable barriers: walls, stairs, crushing boxes.
fruit.grandline.calm.desc: Silence every sound around you or around what you touch.
fruit.grandline.heal.desc: Heal wounds with tears and spores of light.
fruit.grandline.biscuit.desc: Make hard biscuit soldiers and armour.
fruit.grandline.soul.desc: Take people's lifespan and give souls to objects: living suns, clouds and swords.
fruit.grandline.mirror.desc: Make mirrors that reflect attacks and open into the Mirro-World.
fruit.grandline.lick.desc: Make and shape hard candy: cages, spears, walls.
fruit.grandline.wring.desc: Wring anything dry and take its moisture to grow.
fruit.grandline.memory.desc: Pull out, edit and erase memories like film.
fruit.grandline.heat.desc: Heat your body hot enough to boil the sea.
fruit.grandline.castle.desc: Become a living fortress with soldiers inside and cannons outside.
fruit.grandline.clothes.desc: Make clothes out of anything and dress anyone in an instant.
fruit.grandline.time.desc: Leap forward through time, and send others with you.
fruit.grandline.ripe.desc: Ripen anything you touch until it rots.
fruit.grandline.millet.desc: Make millet dumplings that tame any beast that eats them.
fruit.grandline.gold.desc: Shape any gold you have touched into weapons, giants and prisons.
fruit.grandline.song.desc: Pull listeners into a world made of song.
fruit.grandline.warp.desc: Warp yourself and others to anywhere you can see.
fruit.grandline.magnet.desc: Magnetise and control metal: pull, repel and build an arm of scrap.
fruit.grandline.gravity.desc: Control gravity: crush, lift, and call meteors from space.
fruit.grandline.age.desc: Make anyone older or younger, yourself included, even into a possible future.
fruit.grandline.brain.desc: A brain that never stops growing: perfect recall and genius invention.
fruit.grandline.genie.desc: Summon a giant genie of smoke from your body.
fruit.grandline.straw.desc: Become straw: straw dolls take your wounds for you.
fruit.grandline.tone.desc: Turn your body into instruments; each note is an attack.
fruit.grandline.guzzle.desc: Turn the alcohol you drink into fire breath.
fruit.grandline.island.desc: Merge with the land itself: an island that fights for you.
fruit.grandline.push.desc: Push and knead the ground like clay.
fruit.grandline.return.desc: Send anything you touch back in time.
fruit.grandline.sprout.desc: Make plants grow explosively in an instant.
fruit.grandline.luck.desc: Steal the luck of anyone you touch.
fruit.grandline.human.desc: An animal that eats it gains a human form and a human mind.
fruit.grandline.falcon.desc: Become a great falcon and rule the skies.
fruit.grandline.jackal.desc: Become a jackal with fearsome jaws.
fruit.grandline.mole.desc: Become a mole and tunnel through the ground.
fruit.grandline.bison.desc: Become a charging bison with crushing horns.
fruit.grandline.wolf.desc: Become a wolf: speed, fangs and a hunter's nose.
fruit.grandline.giraffe.desc: Become a giraffe: a neck like a battering ram and legs like blades.
fruit.grandline.horse.desc: Become a horse, or a winged pegasus if a bird eats it.
fruit.grandline.anaconda.desc: Become an anaconda: constrict and crush.
fruit.grandline.king_cobra.desc: Become a king cobra: venom and a scorching hood.
fruit.grandline.axolotl.desc: Become an axolotl of living poison gas.
fruit.grandline.albatross.desc: Become an albatross and soar over the sea.
fruit.grandline.tanuki.desc: Become a tanuki and transform into objects.
fruit.grandline.elephant.desc: Become an elephant: tusks, trunk and earth-shaking stomps.
fruit.grandline.pteranodon.desc: Become a pteranodon: flight, speed and a crushing beak.
fruit.grandline.triceratops.desc: Become a triceratops with a spinning frill.
fruit.grandline.pachycephalosaurus.desc: Become a pachycephalosaurus with an iron skull.
fruit.grandline.spider.desc: Become an ancient spider: webs and burning silk.
fruit.grandline.phoenix.desc: Become a phoenix wreathed in blue flames that heal.
fruit.grandline.azure_dragon.desc: Become an azure dragon that rides the clouds and breathes fire.
fruit.grandline.yamata: Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi
fruit.grandline.yamata.desc: Become an eight-headed serpent that lives as long as one head does.
item.grandline.yamata_fruit: Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi
fruit.grandline.nine_tailed_fox.desc: Become a nine-tailed fox and take anyone's form.
fruit.grandline.okuchi_wolf: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami
fruit.grandline.okuchi_wolf.desc: Become a divine wolf guardian of ice.
item.grandline.okuchi_wolf_fruit: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami
fruit.grandline.buddha.desc: Become a giant golden Buddha whose palms send shockwaves.
fruit.grandline.bakotsu.desc: Become a skeletal horse whose blade freezes what it cuts.
fruit.grandline.sandworm.desc: Become an enormous sandworm that devours the land.
ability.grandline.black_hole.desc: Spread darkness under your feet that drags in and crushes everything around it.
ability.grandline.kurouzu.desc: A whirlpool of darkness from your hand yanks your target straight into your grip.
ability.grandline.dark_matter.desc: Throw a ball of compressed darkness: where it lands, a small black hole opens.
ability.grandline.liberation.desc: Release everything the darkness swallowed in one violent blast ahead of you.
ability.grandline.darkness_nullify.desc: Seize a foe: darkness smothers their Devil Fruit, leaving them powerless and solid.
ability.grandline.black_world.desc: Drown a whole area in darkness: everyone in it is blinded, dragged and crushed.
ability.grandline.abyss_gate.desc: Pull every creature around you into your hands and hold them there.
ability.grandline.root_snare.desc: Roots burst out of the ground where you point, binding the legs of everyone nearby.
ability.grandline.vine_lash.desc: A sweeping lash of thorned vines that cuts everyone in front of you and drags them in.
ability.grandline.nutrient_drain.desc: Hold to drink the life from every creature around you, healing as they wither. Rooted foes give twice as much.
ability.grandline.timber_wall.desc: Raise a wall of living timber in front of you.
ability.grandline.thorn_field.desc: Carpet the ground with thorns: anyone who walks through them is slowed and cut.
ability.grandline.great_forest.desc: Become a forest: a vast wildwood springs up around you that seizes and drains everyone in it.
ability.grandline.giant_tree.desc: A giant tree erupts where you point, hurling everyone standing there into the sky.
ability.grandline.gastanet.desc: A pocket of gas where you look, then a snap of your fingers: it explodes.
ability.grandline.shinokuni.desc: Release a spreading cloud of poison gas: anyone inside is poisoned and slowed.
ability.grandline.oxygen_theft.desc: Hold: take the oxygen from around your target. It chokes, reels and weakens while you keep it up.
ability.grandline.gas_rocket.desc: Ignite the gas beneath you and rocket away, leaving an explosion behind.
ability.grandline.gas_bombs.desc: Throw three canisters of gas that burst into small poison clouds.
ability.grandline.noxious_domain.desc: Become a poison storm: a huge cloud that follows you and poisons everyone in it.
ability.grandline.gamma_knife.desc: A beam of lethal radiation-laced gas that pierces everyone in a line, poisoning them deeply.
ability.grandline.yasakani_no_magatama.d: Hold to fire a stream of light bullets that burst where they land.
ability.grandline.ama_no_murakumo.desc: Form a sword of light and cut in a wide arc.
ability.grandline.light_speed_kick.desc: Arrive at your target at the speed of light with a kick that sends it flying.
ability.grandline.light_laser.desc: A laser from your fingertip that pierces everything in a long line.
ability.grandline.light_travel.desc: Become light and appear far ahead in an instant.
ability.grandline.amaterasu.desc: A flash as bright as the sun: everyone around is blinded, burned and left glowing.
ability.grandline.light_rain.desc: Lasers rain from the sky over an area for several seconds.
ability.grandline.ice_age.desc: Freeze everything in front of you: creatures are sealed in ice and the water turns solid.
ability.grandline.ice_saber.desc: Form a sword of ice and cut in a wide arc: deep cold slows whoever it touches.
ability.grandline.partisan.desc: A fan of ice spears that pierce everything and freeze it to the bone.
ability.grandline.pheasant_beak.desc: Charge a great bird of ice and send it diving: it bursts and freezes everything around the impact.
ability.grandline.ice_time.desc: Touch a foe and seal it in ice for a long time.
ability.grandline.ice_wall.desc: Raise a wall of solid ice in front of you.
ability.grandline.glacial_world.desc: The world around you freezes over: every enemy in a huge circle is sealed in ice.
ability.grandline.ice_time_capsule.desc: Seal a foe in a capsule of ice that holds for a long time and wounds as it forms.
ability.grandline.great_eruption.desc: Charge a fist of magma and launch it: it explodes and leaves the ground molten.
ability.grandline.hound_blaze.desc: Lunge forward as a hound of magma and bite down on whatever is in front of you.
ability.grandline.meteor_volcano.desc: Hurl magma into the sky: it comes down as a rain of molten fists around where you look.
ability.grandline.magma_pool.desc: Melt the ground around you into a pool of magma that burns anyone standing in it.
ability.grandline.volcanic_pillars.desc: Pillars of magma burst out of the ground in a line toward where you look.
ability.grandline.volcano_field.desc: The ground around you becomes a volcano: eruptions keep bursting at random for several seconds.
ability.grandline.magma_tsunami.desc: A wall of magma rolls forward, burning and sweeping away everything in its path.
ability.grandline.el_thor.desc: Gather lightning, then call down a pillar of it wherever you look.
ability.grandline.vari.desc: A million volts in every direction: everyone around you is struck and locked up for a moment.
ability.grandline.sango.desc: A bolt from your hand that jumps from the first foe it hits to the ones beside it.
ability.grandline.thunder_spear.desc: Hurl a spear of lightning that passes straight through everyone in its path.
ability.grandline.thunder_travel.desc: Travel as a bolt to where you look; landing discharges into anyone nearby.
ability.grandline.raigo.desc: Summon a thunder cloud over an area: bolts keep falling on anyone beneath it.
ability.grandline.mamaragan.desc: Lightning falls on every enemy for a great distance around you at once.
ability.grandline.desert_spada.desc: A blade of sand races along the ground, splitting it and cutting everyone in its path.
ability.grandline.sables.desc: Send a sandstorm rolling forward that pulls in, blinds and grinds down everything it passes.
ability.grandline.ground_secco.desc: Grip a foe and drink the water from their body: heavy damage, weakness and thirst. You recover a little.
ability.grandline.desert_girasole.desc: Turn the ground ahead into quicksand that holds and slowly swallows anyone caught in it.
ability.grandline.sand_shift.desc: Scatter into sand and reform further ahead.
ability.grandline.desert_encierro.desc: A pillar of sand closes around your target, holding it fast while it dries out.
ability.grandline.great_sandstorm.desc: Become the eye of a great sandstorm that blinds, starves and grinds everyone around you.
ability.grandline.white_blow.desc: A fist of smoke that seizes whoever it hits and drags them back to you.
ability.grandline.white_snake.desc: Three serpents of smoke hunt the nearest enemies and coil around their legs.
ability.grandline.white_launcher.desc: Turn into a jet of smoke and blast forward, bowling over anything in the way.
ability.grandline.white_out.desc: Flood the area with smoke: enemies inside are blinded and slowed, and you vanish within it.
ability.grandline.smoke_ride.desc: Become a drifting cloud and fly. Drains stamina while airborne.
ability.grandline.white_prison.desc: Smoke engulfs a whole area and hardens around everyone in it.
ability.grandline.white_vortex.desc: Hold to become a cyclone of smoke that drags everything nearby into you.
ability.grandline.kamakura.desc: Raise a dome of packed snow around yourself: a shelter, or a trap for whoever is inside with you.
ability.grandline.snow_rabbits.desc: Four rabbits of snow bound off after the nearest enemies, freezing whoever they reach.
ability.grandline.blizzard.desc: Hold to blast a freezing blizzard ahead of you that pushes enemies back.
ability.grandline.snowfield.desc: Blanket the ground in snow: enemies wade through it slowly while it speeds you up.
ability.grandline.snow_burial.desc: Bury your target in a mound of snow that holds it fast.
ability.grandline.white_land.desc: Turn the land around you into a frozen white waste that slows and freezes everyone in it.
ability.grandline.avalanche.desc: Send an avalanche rolling forward that buries and sweeps away everyone in its path.
ability.grandline.swamp_pit.desc: Turn the ground where you look into a bottomless swamp: anyone in it sinks and cannot get out.
ability.grandline.swamp_swallow.desc: The swamp in your body opens up and swallows a nearby foe whole, then holds it.
ability.grandline.mud_shot.desc: Hold to spray a stream of heavy mud that bogs down whoever it hits.
ability.grandline.bottomless_body.desc: Let your body turn to swamp: arrows and other projectiles sink into you harmlessly (and are kept).
ability.grandline.swamp_spew.desc: Spit out everything the swamp swallowed in a crushing torrent. More stored, more damage.
ability.grandline.endless_swamp.desc: The whole area around you becomes swamp.
ability.grandline.swamp_grave.desc: Everyone around you is dragged under the mud and held there.
ability.grandline.bomb_nose_cannon.desc: Flick an explosive bogey at a foe. It goes off on contact.
ability.grandline.bomb_kick.desc: Kick with an exploding leg, blasting whatever stands in front of you.
ability.grandline.bomb_breath_bomb.desc: Breathe out a cloud of explosive air where you point; a second later it detonates.
ability.grandline.bomb_finger_mines.desc: Plant three finger mines in a spread where you point; each goes off under the first foe that steps on it.
ability.grandline.bomb_tackle.desc: Charge headlong; your body explodes on the first foe you touch (or when the charge runs out).
ability.grandline.bomb_full_body.desc: Turn your whole body into a bomb and detonate, blasting everything around you away. You walk out unhurt.
ability.grandline.bomb_barrage.desc: Hold to fire a rapid stream of exploding shots.
ability.grandline.chop_cannon.desc: Fire your detached fist at a foe like a cannonball.
ability.grandline.chop_grab.desc: Send your hand flying to grab a distant foe and drag it back to you.
ability.grandline.chop_festival.desc: Hold to burst into pieces that whirl around you, battering everything close by.
ability.grandline.chop_escape.desc: Fly apart as a blow lands and reassemble a few steps back, untouched.
ability.grandline.chop_senbei.desc: Spin your legs into a disc that skims along the ground through every foe in its way.
ability.grandline.chop_cyclone.desc: Hold to become a whirlwind of body parts that drags foes in and pounds them.
ability.grandline.chop_knife_rain.desc: Dozens of detached hands carry knives over the area you point at, then let them rain down.
ability.grandline.clone_memoire.desc: Touch a creature or player in front of you to memorise its face and body (a light slap, too).
ability.grandline.clone_mimic.desc: Take the face and body you memorised. Creatures of that kind won't attack you unless you hurt them.
ability.grandline.clone_swan_kick.desc: Two quick ballet kicks to whoever is in front of you.
ability.grandline.clone_arabesque.desc: Dart forward in a ballet leap, kicking straight through a line of foes.
ability.grandline.clone_haute_couture.de: Hold for a whirling flurry of pointed-toe kicks.
ability.grandline.clone_army.desc: Copy the creature you memorised three times over: three doubles fight for you for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.clone_grand_ballet.des: Spin on one toe with your leg outstretched, kicking everything around you away.
ability.grandline.dice_atomic_spar.desc: Cross your blade-arms and cut everything in front of you twice.
ability.grandline.dice_spar_claw.desc: Dash through a line of foes with your blade-arms out, slicing everyone you pass.
ability.grandline.dice_spider.desc: Turn your whole body to steel: tougher than armour, and bare-handed attackers cut themselves on you.
ability.grandline.dice_blade_spin.desc: Hold to spin with blades out on every side, cutting everything close to you.
ability.grandline.dice_steel_thrust.desc: Lunge with your arm as a single long blade, piercing everything in a straight line.
ability.grandline.dice_blade_field.desc: Turn the ground around you into a bed of blades: anyone standing on it is cut and slowed.
ability.grandline.dice_guillotine.desc: Throw a giant cross of steel that cuts through everything in its path.
ability.grandline.flower_clutch.desc: Sprout arms on a foe's body and bend it backwards until something gives.
ability.grandline.flower_grab.desc: Arms burst out of the ground around a spot and hold everyone there by the legs.
ability.grandline.flower_ojos.desc: Eyes bloom all around you: every creature within thirty blocks is outlined, even through walls.
ability.grandline.flower_wing.desc: Grow wings of arms from your back and fly.
ability.grandline.flower_gigantesco.desc: Two giant hands rise from the ground where you point and clap together.
ability.grandline.flower_campanula.desc: A field of a thousand arms blooms around you, seizing and crushing everyone in it.
ability.grandline.flower_demonio.desc: Cloak yourself in countless arms and tower over the battlefield as a giant.
ability.grandline.kilo_feather_weight.de: Become as light as a feather: jump high, fall slowly and ride the wind.
ability.grandline.kilo_press.desc: Leap up and turn to ten tonnes: you crash down on everyone below, harder the higher you fell.
ability.grandline.kilo_heavy_body.desc: Settle into ten thousand kilos: nothing can push you, blows hurt less, but you move slowly.
ability.grandline.kilo_weight_kick.desc: Shift your whole weight into one kick that sends a foe flying.
ability.grandline.kilo_bounce.desc: Drop to one kilogram in the middle of a jump and let the push carry you high into the air.
ability.grandline.kilo_ten_ton_field.des: Everything around you grows unbearably heavy: foes are pinned, grounded and slowly crushed.
ability.grandline.kilo_feather_field.des: Make everything around you weigh nothing: foes float helplessly up, then fall when the effect ends.
ability.grandline.mochi_zan_giri.desc: Stretch your arm into a thick rope of mochi and slam it through everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.mochi_mogura.desc: Throw Mogura, your trident of mochi, straight through a line of enemies.
ability.grandline.mochi_kaku_mochi.desc: Wrap a foe in a ball of mochi that sets hard: it can neither move nor fight until it breaks free.
ability.grandline.mochi_sticky_floor.des: Spread sticky mochi over the ground: anyone who steps in gets stuck.
ability.grandline.mochi_ryusei_kazan.des: Hold to unleash a storm of mochi fists, each one bulging from the last.
ability.grandline.mochi_buto_mochi.desc: A colossal fist of mochi bursts up out of the ground where you point.
ability.grandline.mochi_mochi_world.desc: Turn the land around you into mochi: everyone in it is slowed, weakened, and periodically swallowed.
ability.grandline.munch_bite.desc: Clamp your huge jaws on a foe in front of you; the bite feeds you a little.
ability.grandline.munch_devour.desc: Eat whatever you hold in your other hand and take on its nature: metal gives an iron body for half a minute, gunpowder or TNT loads your cannon, food heals you.
ability.grandline.munch_cannon.desc: Turn your arm into a cannon and fire a shell you have eaten.
ability.grandline.munch_spit.desc: Gulp down a foe in front of you and spit it far away.
ability.grandline.munch_swallow.desc: Hold your mouth wide open: arrows and other projectiles flying at you are eaten and become cannon shells.
ability.grandline.munch_tank.desc: Eat your way into a body like a tank: huge, armoured, and running down anything in front of it.
ability.grandline.munch_factory.desc: Fire every shell in your belly at once in a roaring spread (at least three).
ability.grandline.op_room.desc: Open a sphere of space you control. Inside it you see every living thing, and your other techniques work.
ability.grandline.op_shambles.desc: Swap places with the creature you point at inside your Room, or jump to any spot in it.
ability.grandline.op_amputate.desc: Sweep a blade through everyone in front of you inside the Room: bodies come apart, slowed and weakened.
ability.grandline.op_mes.desc: Take the heart out of a creature in your Room: it weakens and glows wherever it runs. Use Mes again while holding the heart to squeeze it.
ability.grandline.op_counter_shock.desc: Press both palms to a foe and release a defibrillator's jolt that knocks it out cold.
ability.grandline.op_gamma_knife.desc: A blade of energy that cuts the organs inside a body without touching the skin.
ability.grandline.op_takt.desc: Lift every creature in your Room into the air and hold it there, then let it fall.
ability.grandline.slip_spur.desc: Skate forward on frictionless skin, bowling over everyone in your way.
ability.grandline.slip_slick_skin.desc: Turn your skin truly frictionless: you move faster and every blow slides off you.
ability.grandline.slip_oil_slick.desc: Smear the ground ahead with slick oil from your skin: anyone on it skids helplessly around.
ability.grandline.slip_wriggle.desc: Slip out of anything that holds you: bindings, casings and slowness all slide off, and you dart away.
ability.grandline.slip_counter.desc: For three seconds, the next blow that reaches you slides off and leaves its owner stumbling.
ability.grandline.slip_frictionless.desc: Take the friction out of everything around you: foes skid, stumble and cannot land a solid blow.
ability.grandline.slip_spiral.desc: Hold to spin across the ground in a frictionless whirl that batters everything around.
ability.grandline.spike_sting.desc: Grow a long spike from your fingertip and stab straight through whatever is in front of you.
ability.grandline.spike_volley.desc: Fire a fan of five spikes from your arm.
ability.grandline.spike_ground_spikes.de: Drive spikes up out of the ground where you point, impaling and tossing everyone standing there.
ability.grandline.spike_hair_flail.desc: Whip your hair, now a mass of needles, across everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.spike_forest.desc: A ring of spikes bursts out of the ground around you and races outward, impaling everyone it passes.
ability.grandline.spike_rolling_urchin.d: Hold to curl into a giant spiked ball and roll forward, flattening everything in your path.
ability.grandline.string_overheat.desc: Lash out with a red-hot rope of string that cuts and burns everything along its length.
ability.grandline.string_bullet_string.d: Hold to flick hardened string bullets from your fingertips; each one pierces straight through.
ability.grandline.string_parasite.desc: Sink invisible strings into a foe: it is held in place, and a beast turns on the nearest creature beside it.
ability.grandline.string_sky_walk.desc: Hook your strings onto the clouds and walk on the air.
ability.grandline.string_five_color.desc: Five strings slash down from above where you point, cutting through everyone beneath.
ability.grandline.string_birdcage.desc: Drop a cage of strings over the whole area. It closes slowly, cutting anyone who touches its walls.
ability.grandline.string_god_thread.desc: Twist a thousand strings into one spear and drive it through everything in a line.
ability.grandline.tremor_quake_punch.des: Charge a punch and crack the air in front of you: a shockwave blasts everyone in front of you away.
ability.grandline.tremor_quake_bubble.de: Hurl a bubble of trembling air that bursts into a quake wherever it lands.
ability.grandline.tremor_ground_quake.de: Punch the ground: the quake throws everyone around you into the air and leaves them reeling.
ability.grandline.tremor_air_step.desc: Crack the air behind you and ride the shockwave forward; whoever stood next to you is blown away.
ability.grandline.tremor_quake_fists.des: Wrap your fists in quake bubbles: every punch shatters the air and hurls its target away.
ability.grandline.tremor_sea_quake.desc: Grip the air and tilt the world: a vast quake flings everything for twenty blocks around you skyward.
ability.grandline.tremor_sky_crack.desc: Charge both fists and crack the sky itself: a colossal shockwave tears through everything in a straight line.
ability.grandline.wax_candle_lock.desc: Seal a foe's feet in hardened wax.
ability.grandline.wax_arrows.desc: Loose three arrows of hard wax; each one pins its target where it stands.
ability.grandline.wax_candle_wall.desc: Raise a wall of wax harder than steel in front of you.
ability.grandline.wax_candle_armor.desc: Coat yourself in armour of hardened wax: blows hurt far less, but you move a little slower.
ability.grandline.wax_service_set.desc: Seal a foe entirely in wax on a spinning cake stand: it cannot move or act.
ability.grandline.wax_candle_house.desc: Wall yourself and everyone near you inside a great dome of wax.
ability.grandline.wax_candle_champion.de: Build a giant suit of wax around yourself and fight from inside it.
ability.grandline.berry_scatter.desc: Scatter into balls and reassemble right behind the nearest foe, striking as you form.
ability.grandline.berry_ball_barrage.des: Fling a handful of your own body's balls at your foes.
ability.grandline.berry_roll.desc: Your balls roll out in a line, bowling over and tripping everyone in the way.
ability.grandline.berry_net.desc: Balls cluster around a foe like a sticky net and pin it in place.
ability.grandline.berry_loose_body.desc: Hold your body loosely together: most blows pass between the balls, and you move quicker.
ability.grandline.berry_swarm.desc: Hold to dissolve into a swarm of hundreds of balls that whirl around you and pound everything nearby.
ability.grandline.berry_giant_berry.desc: Pack every ball together into one giant berry and drop it on the spot you point at.
ability.grandline.bind_awase_baori.desc: Sweep your arm through everyone in front of you: it comes out the other side in iron bands.
ability.grandline.bind_black_cage.desc: Lock a foe from head to toe in iron bonds: it can neither move nor fight.
ability.grandline.bind_band_shot.desc: Throw a ring of iron that snaps shut around the first foe it hits.
ability.grandline.bind_shackle_ring.desc: Iron bands spring up in a ring where you point and clamp every pair of legs inside it.
ability.grandline.bind_iron_grip.desc: Harden your stance: every bare-handed blow that reaches you leaves its owner bound, and you can't be pushed.
ability.grandline.bind_prison.desc: Turn the ground around you into a prison: everyone in it is bound again and again.
ability.grandline.bind_tighten.desc: Every iron bond you have placed nearby tightens at once, crushing whoever wears it.
Blow a stream of golden soap bubbles: each one that bursts on a foe washes its strength away.
ability.grandline.bubble_soap_sheep.desc: Smother a foe in a woolly cloud of soap: it is stuck inside, then comes out scrubbed weak.
ability.grandline.bubble_soap_floor.desc: Lather the ground where you point: anyone on it slips and loses their grip.
ability.grandline.bubble_shield.desc: Hold a big bubble around yourself: projectiles pop against it and anything that touches it is washed weak.
ability.grandline.bubble_ride.desc: Float inside a big soap bubble and drift through the air.
ability.grandline.bubble_cleansing_storm: A storm of bubbles washes everyone around you: weakened, slowed, and scrubbed clean of every blessing.
ability.grandline.bubble_prison.desc: Trap every foe near you in a giant soap bubble that lifts them helplessly off the ground.
ability.grandline.door_wall_door.desc: Open a door in the wall in front of you and walk straight through it, however thick.
ability.grandline.door_body_door.desc: Open a door in a foe's chest and shove: it tumbles out of a door six blocks behind itself.
ability.grandline.door_prison.desc: Push a foe through a door into the empty space behind the world: it is gone for three seconds, then falls out.
ability.grandline.door_slam.desc: Throw a door open in front of you so hard it slams everyone ahead backwards.
ability.grandline.door_air_door.desc: Step through a door into the air itself and hide there, unseen and untouchable, for up to five seconds.
ability.grandline.door_gate.desc: Open a door to anywhere you can see, up to sixty blocks away; whoever stands beside you comes too.
ability.grandline.door_scatter.desc: Doors open under every foe around you at once: they drop through and land scattered far apart.
ability.grandline.rust_touch.desc: Grip a foe: its armour rusts through and it takes damage according to how much metal it wears.
ability.grandline.rust_blade_break.desc: Touch a foe's weapon: if it is a monster's, it rusts to nothing; a player's hand goes numb instead.
ability.grandline.rust_wave.desc: Send a wave of rust flakes over everyone in front of you, corroding their armour.
ability.grandline.rust_veil.desc: Hold up a veil of rust: arrows and other metal flying at you crumble before they land.
ability.grandline.rust_crumble.desc: Lay both hands on a foe and rust everything metal on it at once: the more armour it wears, the more it hurts.
ability.grandline.rust_field.desc: Let rust spread across the ground around you: every bit of metal inside it corrodes, and iron golems fall apart.
ability.grandline.rust_iron_collapse.des: Every armoured foe around you rusts from the inside out, taking damage for every piece of metal it wears.
ability.grandline.slow_beam.desc: Fire slowing photons from your hands: everything they touch crawls for thirty seconds.
ability.grandline.slow_beam_sword.desc: Swing a sword-shaped beam of photons: whoever it cuts is slowed.
ability.grandline.slow_combo.desc: Rain blows on a slowed foe faster than it can react: six hits in an instant.
ability.grandline.slow_field.desc: Bathe an area in Noro Noro photons: creatures and projectiles inside it slow to a crawl.
ability.grandline.slow_shield.desc: Hold up your hands: every projectile flying near you crawls to a stop in mid-air.
ability.grandline.slow_world.desc: Flood everything around you with photons: the whole battlefield moves in slow motion except you.
ability.grandline.slow_full_beam.desc: A huge photon beam that slows and weakens everything in its path for thirty seconds.
ability.grandline.spike_urchin.desc: Bristle all over with spikes: anything close is pricked, and hitting you hurts twice as much.
ability.grandline.spring_hopper.desc: Coil your legs and spring far in the direction you face.
ability.grandline.spring_sniper.desc: Uncoil a spring-loaded punch that hits ten blocks away.
ability.grandline.spring_legs.desc: Keep your legs as springs: you jump far higher and land without a scratch.
ability.grandline.spring_death_knock.des: Ricochet from foe to foe, striking up to four of them in a blink.
ability.grandline.spring_pinball.desc: Launch yourself forward; for two seconds every wall bounces you back faster, bowling over foes.
ability.grandline.spring_field.desc: Turn the ground around you into springs: anyone standing on it is flung into the air again and again.
ability.grandline.spring_cannonball.desc: Compress every spring in your body and fire yourself through a line of foes.
ability.grandline.wheel_legs.desc: Turn your legs into wheels and race along the ground, rolling up steps as you go.
ability.grandline.wheel_ram.desc: Charge forward on your wheels and ram straight through a line of foes.
ability.grandline.wheel_grinder.desc: Spin your arms as grinding wheels and shred whatever is in front of you.
ability.grandline.wheel_throw.desc: Fling a spinning wheel that cuts through every foe in its path.
ability.grandline.wheel_drift.desc: Hold to spin out in tight circles, battering everything around you.
ability.grandline.wheel_road_roller.desc: Become one giant wheel and roll over everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.wheel_storm.desc: Six wheels fly out from you in every direction, cutting through everyone around.
ability.grandline.clear_vanish.desc: Turn completely invisible. Monsters more than two blocks away lose track of you while it lasts.
ability.grandline.clear_unseen_strike.de: Strike the foe in front of you. From invisibility the blow lands where nobody saw it coming, for double damage.
ability.grandline.clear_veil.desc: Lay a hand on everyone beside you and share your power: you and nearby players turn invisible for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.clear_phase_step.desc: Vanish and reappear right behind the foe you point at.
ability.grandline.clear_blind_spot.desc: Fade from every eye around you: monsters lose your trail and are left half-blind.
ability.grandline.clear_world.desc: Everything near you goes clear: allies vanish, foes lose sight of the world around them.
An invisible sword cut that runs a long way ahead, hitting everything in its line before anyone sees it.
ability.grandline.hollow_negative.desc: Send a ghost through a foe: it collapses in despair, too miserable to fight.
ability.grandline.hollow_ghost_rap.desc: Three grinning ghosts float after your foes and explode when they touch them.
ability.grandline.hollow_mini_hollows.de: A swarm of tiny ghosts nibbles at nearby foes, sapping their strength.
ability.grandline.hollow_astral.desc: Leave your body behind as a ghost: invisible, floating, and free to roam for a while.
ability.grandline.hollow_negative_wave.d: A wave of negative ghosts washes over everyone around you, crushing their will to fight.
ability.grandline.hollow_ghost_parade.de: Hold to release a parade of ghosts that stream out and chase down everyone in sight.
ability.grandline.hollow_toku_hollow.des: Send one huge ghost after your foes; it explodes in a great blast of despair.
ability.grandline.love_mellow.desc: Form a heart with your hands and fire a beam of love: everyone it catches turns to stone.
ability.grandline.love_slave_arrow.desc: Draw back a bow of love and loose a volley of heart arrows that seek out your foes.
ability.grandline.love_pistol_kiss.desc: Blow a kiss that flies like a bullet: it strikes hard and turns the target's feet to stone.
ability.grandline.love_perfume_femur.des: A kick that turns whatever it strikes to stone before it lands.
ability.grandline.love_shatter.desc: Shatter the stone around every petrified foe near you: each takes a heavy blow and is released.
ability.grandline.love_wave.desc: A wave of love pours out all around you: everyone it reaches turns to stone.
ability.grandline.love_aphrodite.desc: A great heart of love flies ahead, striking and petrifying everything in its path.
ability.grandline.paw_pad_cannon.desc: Slap the air: a paw-shaped blast of compressed air flies out and hurls aside whatever it hits.
ability.grandline.paw_repel.desc: Push with both paws: everything around you, people and projectiles alike, is repelled away.
ability.grandline.paw_travel: Where Would You Like to Travel?
ability.grandline.paw_travel.desc: Touch a foe with a paw and send it flying far over the horizon.
ability.grandline.paw_pain_extraction.de: Repel the pain and fatigue out of your own body; the pain takes shape and you hurl it into a foe.
ability.grandline.paw_ursus_shock.desc: Charge, then release a compressed paw of air that drifts forward and explodes with crushing force.
ability.grandline.paw_leap.desc: Repel your own body: you vanish and land wherever you are looking, up to fifty blocks away.
ability.grandline.paw_pain_bubble.desc: Extract a foe's own pain into a bubble and push it back in all at once: it reels, knocked out for a moment.
ability.grandline.revive_soul_solid.desc: Swing a blade chilled by the underworld: everything it cuts starts to freeze.
ability.grandline.revive_soul_parade.des: Walk past a line of foes at a stroll; a heartbeat later every one of them is cut.
ability.grandline.revive_soul_projection: Let your soul slip out of your body and drift unseen through the air, scouting freely.
ability.grandline.revive_fubuki.desc: A freezing sweep of the sword that seals foes in ice.
ability.grandline.revive_lullaby.desc: Hold to play a soothing tune: monsters nearby fall asleep, players grow drowsy.
ability.grandline.revive_underworld_chil: Open the cold of the underworld around you: everyone nearby freezes slowly while it lasts.
ability.grandline.revive_soul_pound.desc: A single slash carrying the underworld's full cold: it cuts in a long line and freezes solid.
ability.grandline.shadow_steal.desc: Cut the shadow from a foe's feet: it is left weak and slow, and the shadow is yours to use.
ability.grandline.shadow_brick_bat.desc: Your shadow breaks into a flock of bats that hunt down your foes.
ability.grandline.shadow_doppelman.desc: Your shadow peels off the ground and fights beside you for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.shadow_revolution.desc: Trade places with your Doppelman in an instant.
ability.grandline.shadow_tsuno_tokage.de: A horned lizard of shadow bursts up out of a foe's own shadow and impales it.
ability.grandline.shadow_asgard.desc: Swallow every shadow you hold (and steal those of foes beside you) to swell into a giant: the more shadows, the bigger and stronger. They are spent when it ends.
ability.grandline.shadow_nightmare.desc: Tear the shadow from every foe around you at once: they reel blind and weak while you gather their shadows.
ability.grandline.arms_blade_arm.desc: Turn your arm into a sword and cut through everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.arms_gun_fingers.desc: Hold to turn your fingers into gun barrels and fire a stream of bullets.
ability.grandline.arms_missile.desc: Your arm opens into a launcher and fires a missile that steers toward the nearest foe.
ability.grandline.arms_axe_leg.desc: Turn your leg into a great axe and bring it down on whatever stands in front of you.
ability.grandline.arms_armour_plates.des: Grow steel plates over your body: much harder to hurt, a little slower.
ability.grandline.arms_arsenal.desc: Every limb opens into a launcher at once: six missiles streak out and hunt down your foes.
ability.grandline.arms_body_cannon.desc: Charge, then turn your whole body into a cannon and fire one enormous shell.
ability.grandline.art_brush_stroke.desc: One sweeping brush stroke turns the foe in front of you into a twisted work of art.
ability.grandline.art_paint_splash.desc: Fling three blots of paint; whoever they splash is blinded and slowed.
ability.grandline.art_canvas.desc: Turn the ground where you point into an abstract canvas: anyone on it staggers in confusion.
ability.grandline.art_frame.desc: Hang a foe in a picture frame: it is held fast inside the painting for three seconds.
ability.grandline.art_masterpiece.desc: Finish your work: every foe you have turned into art nearby takes a blow straight to the soul.
ability.grandline.art_gallery.desc: Turn the whole place around you into an abstract gallery: everyone in it is twisted, lost and slowly drained.
ability.grandline.art_sculpture.desc: A giant abstract sculpture crashes down where you point, flattening and twisting everyone beneath.
ability.grandline.float_levitate.desc: Make yourself float and sail through the sky.
ability.grandline.float_boulder.desc: Touch the ground, float a boulder out of it and hurl it.
ability.grandline.float_ground_lift.desc: Float the ground out from under everyone at the spot you point at; they hang in the air, then fall.
ability.grandline.float_earth_lion.desc: Shape a lion out of the earth, float it, and send it hunting your foes.
ability.grandline.float_sword_legs.desc: Slash with the swords that are your legs, cutting everything around you.
ability.grandline.float_island_drop.desc: Float a chunk of island high overhead and drop it on the spot you point at.
ability.grandline.float_lion_pride.desc: Raise four lions of earth at once; they hunt down your foes and burst over them.
ability.grandline.glare_clairvoyance.des: See through every wall: all living things within fifty blocks are outlined for you.
ability.grandline.glare_read_mind.desc: Look into a creature's mind: learn how hurt it is and what it means to do, and react faster for five seconds.
ability.grandline.glare_paralyzing_glare: A piercing glare that freezes a creature where it stands (players only falter for a moment).
ability.grandline.glare_weak_point.desc: See straight through a foe to its weak point: for ten seconds it takes half again as much damage from you.
ability.grandline.glare_mind_strike.desc: Strike exactly where a foe's mind least expects it: damage that ignores armour and leaves it reeling.
ability.grandline.glare_all_seeing.desc: See every foe around you through and through: all of them are outlined, weak points exposed.
ability.grandline.glare_foresight.desc: Read every mind around you for fifteen seconds: half of all attacks against you simply miss.
ability.grandline.hormone_healing.desc: Inject healing hormones into yourself, or into the player in front of you: wounds close at once.
ability.grandline.hormone_tension.desc: Pump yourself full of tension hormones: faster, stronger, tireless, until the crash when it ends.
ability.grandline.hormone_needle_shot.de: Fire hormone-filled needles from your fingers: a foe they hit grows weak, sluggish and dizzy.
ability.grandline.hormone_growth.desc: Inject growth hormones into yourself: you swell to a giant's size and strength for a while.
ability.grandline.hormone_shrink.desc: Stab a foe with shrinking hormones: it dwindles to half its size and hits far more weakly for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.hormone_surge.desc: Flood everyone around you with hormones: friends are healed and fired up, foes are left feeble.
ability.grandline.hormone_death_wink.des: Wink with hormone-charged force: a gale of wind blasts everything in front of you away.
ability.grandline.mark_touch.desc: Touch a creature to mark it for a minute: it glows, and everything you throw will find it.
ability.grandline.mark_knife.desc: Throw a knife. If you have a mark, the knife curves through the air to it.
ability.grandline.mark_volley.desc: Fan out five knives; every one of them turns toward your mark.
ability.grandline.mark_anchor_drop.desc: Heave an anchor high into the air; it comes down on your mark wherever it hides.
ability.grandline.mark_barrage.desc: Hold to keep throwing knives at your mark as fast as your hands can move.
ability.grandline.mark_all.desc: Mark every foe around you at once.
ability.grandline.mark_ship_drop.desc: Hurl something enormous into the sky; a piece of it falls on every creature you have marked.
ability.grandline.ripple_flag_cape.desc: Hold up your steel cape: projectiles from in front ripple off it back the way they came, and blows hit softer.
ability.grandline.ripple_flutter_blade.d: Your blade flutters like cloth and reaches far further than it should.
ability.grandline.ripple_ground_flag.des: Ripple the ground in a line ahead of you like a flag snapping in the wind: everyone on it is tossed up.
ability.grandline.ripple_steel_banner.de: Stiffen your cape into a wall of steel bars in front of you.
ability.grandline.ripple_whip_sword.desc: Your sword ripples into a long whip that lashes a line of foes and drags them toward you.
ability.grandline.ripple_rolling_land.de: The whole land around you rolls like a flag in a storm, tossing everyone on it again and again.
ability.grandline.ripple_cape_storm.desc: Hold to whirl your rippling cape around you like a storm of blades.
ability.grandline.snip_snip.desc: Snap your scissor-hands shut on everyone in front of you.
ability.grandline.snip_paper_wall.desc: Cut a sheet out of the ground in front of you and stand it upright as a wall.
ability.grandline.snip_thrust.desc: Thrust your scissors forward like a spear, piercing a whole line of foes.
ability.grandline.snip_ground_flip.desc: Cut the ground under the spot you point at and flip it like paper: everyone standing there is thrown up.
ability.grandline.snip_shear.desc: Grab a foe in your scissors and shear: a deep cut that leaves it limping.
ability.grandline.snip_paper_storm.desc: Cut the ground into thin sheets and send them spinning out in a fan, slicing through everything.
ability.grandline.snip_great_shears.desc: Your scissors swell to giant size and close on everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.spin_propeller.desc: Spin your arms like propellers and fly.
ability.grandline.spin_drill.desc: Spin your fist into a drill and drive it through the foes in front of you.
ability.grandline.spin_gale.desc: Whirl your arms to whip up a gale that blows everything in front of you far away.
ability.grandline.spin_liftoff.desc: Grab a foe and spin it straight up into the sky.
ability.grandline.spin_buzzsaw.desc: Hold to spin your whole body like a saw blade, cutting everything around you.
ability.grandline.spin_twister.desc: Spin up a twister and send it rolling forward, sucking foes in and carrying them aloft.
ability.grandline.spin_dive_bomb.desc: Spin like a falling drill and dive onto the spot you point at, smashing everything there.
ability.grandline.stick_mucus_shot.desc: Spit a glob of sticky mucus: whoever it hits is glued to the spot.
ability.grandline.stick_trap.desc: Spread a pool of mucus where you point: anyone who steps in gets stuck.
ability.grandline.stick_coat.desc: Coat yourself in mucus: projectiles stick and lose their force, and anyone who punches you sticks fast.
ability.grandline.stick_ignite.desc: Light the mucus: everyone glued nearby goes up in flames.
ability.grandline.stick_string_pull.desc: Fling a sticky string at a foe and reel it in, glued, to your feet.
ability.grandline.stick_mucus_flood.desc: Flood the area around you with mucus: everyone in it is stuck fast, again and again.
ability.grandline.stick_inferno.desc: Set every drop of mucus around you alight at once: a sea of fire over everyone you have glued.
ability.grandline.stitch_sew_feet.desc: Stitch a foe's feet to the ground; it cannot take a step until the thread gives.
ability.grandline.stitch_needle_volley.d: Throw three needles trailing thread; each one stitches its target in place for a moment.
ability.grandline.stitch_sew_together.de: Sew the two foes nearest the spot you point at to each other: they are dragged together and held there.
ability.grandline.stitch_mend_wounds.des: Stitch your own wounds closed: an instant patch-up and a little regeneration.
ability.grandline.stitch_quilt_wall.desc: Quilt a soft but sturdy wall in front of you out of thin air and thread.
ability.grandline.stitch_patchwork.desc: Sew every foe around you to the ground at once.
ability.grandline.stitch_net.desc: Throw a great stitched net over the spot you point at; everyone under it is bound tight and crushed.
ability.grandline.stone_fist.desc: A fist of stone punches up out of the ground where you point.
ability.grandline.stone_wall.desc: Raise a wall of stone out of the ground in front of you.
ability.grandline.stone_merge.desc: Sink into the stone itself: hidden and nearly untouchable, though slow, until you step back out.
ability.grandline.stone_spike_line.desc: A line of stone spikes bursts out of the ground ahead of you, tossing everyone on it.
ability.grandline.stone_skin.desc: Harden your skin into stone: far tougher, slower on your feet.
ability.grandline.stone_giant.desc: Merge with the land and rise as a stone giant: towering, mighty and with an enormous reach.
ability.grandline.stone_crushing_hands.d: Two giant hands of stone rise on either side of the spot you point at and clap together.
ability.grandline.venom_hydra.desc: Loose a dragon of venom that hunts down a foe and bursts over it in a spray of poison.
ability.grandline.venom_road.desc: Ride a stream of venom forward; everyone along the way is splashed and poisoned.
ability.grandline.venom_chloro_ball.desc: Throw a ball of poison gas that bursts into a lingering, choking cloud.
ability.grandline.venom_poison_cloud.des: Release a great cloud of nerve gas where you point: everyone in it is poisoned and reels.
ability.grandline.venom_coat.desc: Coat your body in venom: every blow you land poisons, and you shrug off a little more damage.
ability.grandline.venom_demon.desc: Become a towering demon of venom: everything near you rots, and your blows poison deeply.
ability.grandline.venom_flood.desc: Unleash a tidal wave of venom that sweeps everything in front of you away.
ability.grandline.wash_scrub.desc: Grab a foe and give it a good scrub: it comes out weak and sluggish.
ability.grandline.wash_wring.desc: Wring a foe out like a wet towel: a crushing twist, and it is left limp.
ability.grandline.wash_hang_to_dry.desc: Hang everyone around the spot you point at out to dry: they dangle helplessly in the air.
ability.grandline.wash_away_evil.desc: Wash the malice out of a monster: it forgets its anger, loses every blessing and takes a cleansing blow.
ability.grandline.wash_suds.desc: Throw a wave of suds over everyone in front of you: they slip and lose their strength.
ability.grandline.wash_great_laundry.des: Do the whole battlefield's laundry at once: everyone near you is washed, wrung and left too limp to fight.
ability.grandline.wash_spin_cycle.desc: Hold to whip up a washing-machine whirl that drags foes in and tumbles them round and round.
ability.grandline.biscuit_soldiers.desc: Clap out two biscuit soldiers that fight for you for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.biscuit_pretzel.desc: Swing Pretzel, your sword, in a wide arc.
ability.grandline.biscuit_armor.desc: Bake a suit of biscuit armour around yourself: very hard, and it crumbles when it ends.
ability.grandline.biscuit_wall.desc: Bake a wall of hard biscuit in front of you.
ability.grandline.biscuit_spear_volley.d: Clap out a volley of biscuit spears and hurl them through the ranks in front of you.
ability.grandline.biscuit_legion.desc: Clap out a legion: six hardened biscuit soldiers, stronger and tougher than the usual batch.
ability.grandline.biscuit_giant.desc: Bake a towering biscuit giant that smashes your foes for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.calm_silent.desc: Make no sound at all: monsters more than four blocks away cannot hear you and lose your trail.
A blow nobody hears coming: it hits twice as hard on a foe that isn't watching you.
ability.grandline.calm_silence_touch.des: Touch a foe and steal its voice: a monster forgets its prey; a player can't use a Devil Fruit for four seconds.
ability.grandline.calm_soundproof_wall.d: Throw a soundproof bubble over the spot you point at: monsters inside lose their quarry and stumble in the dark.
ability.grandline.calm_ambush.desc: Slip silently behind the foe you point at and strike before it hears a thing.
ability.grandline.calm_great_silence.des: Silence everything around you: monsters forget what they were doing, players lose their fruit powers briefly.
ability.grandline.calm_shroud.desc: Wrap yourself and everyone beside you in silence: monsters can't track any of you for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.cream_shot.desc: Fling a dollop of scalding cream that splatters on impact.
ability.grandline.cream_spray.desc: Hold to spray a stream of boiling cream over everyone in front of you.
ability.grandline.cream_floor.desc: Cover the ground where you point with hot cream: anyone wading through it is slowed and burned.
ability.grandline.cream_coat.desc: Cover yourself in scalding cream: attackers burn their hands, and you stay cool.
ability.grandline.cream_smother.desc: Smother a foe in a mound of hot cream: it is stuck fast and burning for three seconds.
ability.grandline.cream_flood.desc: Unleash a rolling wave of boiling cream that sweeps everything in front of you away.
ability.grandline.cream_cake_tomb.desc: Bury every foe around you in a cake of hot cream: they are stuck, burning, for four seconds.
ability.grandline.heal_tears.desc: Shed healing tears: your wounds close and keep closing for a few seconds.
ability.grandline.heal_spores.desc: Release spores of healing light over everyone around you: friends are mended.
ability.grandline.heal_tear_shot.desc: Flick a tear of light: it burns the undead fiercely and stings anything else.
ability.grandline.heal_cleanse.desc: Wash every harmful effect off yourself and every friend beside you.
ability.grandline.heal_dandelion_field.d: Sow a field of glowing dandelions where you point: friends inside heal over time, the undead are seared.
ability.grandline.heal_great_bloom.desc: A great bloom of healing light: every friend nearby is restored and shielded with extra hearts.
ability.grandline.heal_life_shield.desc: Wrap every friend near you in living light: for five seconds they shrug off most harm and heal quickly.
ability.grandline.hobby_toy_touch.desc: Touch a creature and it becomes a toy: small, weak, and (if it's a beast) yours to command for thirty seconds.
ability.grandline.hobby_toy_soldiers.des: Wind up three little toy soldiers that march into battle for you.
ability.grandline.hobby_contract.desc: Remind every toy of its contract: all your toys and soldiers fight harder and faster for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.hobby_toy_box.desc: Snap a toy box shut around a foe: it is locked inside for four seconds.
ability.grandline.hobby_forget.desc: Wipe yourself from every memory around you: monsters forget they were chasing you, players lose sight of you.
ability.grandline.hobby_toy_world.desc: A wave of toy-making washes out from you: every beast nearby becomes one of your toys for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.hobby_toy_parade.desc: Wind up a whole parade of toy soldiers at once.
ability.grandline.jacket_possess.desc: Wrap yourself around a beast like a jacket: for fifteen seconds it fights for you. Players only stagger.
ability.grandline.jacket_sleeve_lash.des: Your sleeves stretch out and lash everyone in front of you.
ability.grandline.jacket_puppet_lunge.de: Your puppets leap at the creature you point at and tear into it.
ability.grandline.jacket_lined_coat.desc: Line yourself with thick padding: tougher and harder to knock down.
ability.grandline.jacket_strangle.desc: Wrap your collar around a foe's throat: it chokes, slows, and a beast passes out for a moment.
ability.grandline.jacket_wardrobe.desc: Split into a whole wardrobe of jackets: every beast around you is worn and turned to your side for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.jacket_straitjacket.de: Clamp every foe around you in a straitjacket: none of them can move or swing for three seconds.
ability.grandline.lick_candy_spear.desc: Throw a spear of hard candy that runs through everything in its path and leaves it sticky.
ability.grandline.lick_candy_wall.desc: Raise a wall of pink candy in front of you.
ability.grandline.lick_candy_cage.desc: Coat a foe in candy that sets hard: it cannot move or act for four seconds.
ability.grandline.lick_candy_floor.desc: Pour a floor of sticky candy where you point: anything that walks onto it is stuck by the feet.
ability.grandline.lick_candy_maiden.desc: Seal a foe in a candy maiden and squeeze: it is held fast and crushed.
ability.grandline.lick_candy_land.desc: Turn the land around you to candy: every two seconds, anything inside is coated and squeezed.
ability.grandline.lick_candy_wave.desc: Send a rolling wave of molten candy forward that sets hard around everything it catches.
ability.grandline.memory_erase.desc: Pluck out a foe's memory of you: a beast forgets the fight for ten seconds; a person is left dazed and lost.
ability.grandline.memory_film_pull.desc: Pull a strip of memory film out of a foe's head: it stands rooted and weakened while it tries to remember.
ability.grandline.memory_rewrite.desc: Splice a false memory into a beast: it now remembers the nearest other creature as its enemy.
ability.grandline.memory_mass_wipe.desc: Wipe the memory of everyone nearby: beasts forget you for fifteen seconds and wander; people stagger, lost.
ability.grandline.memory_false_loyalty.d: Rewrite the loyalties of every beast around you: for fifteen seconds they remember you as their master.
ability.grandline.mirror_reflect.desc: Hold a mirror up in front of you: projectiles that reach it fly straight back at their senders.
ability.grandline.mirror_step.desc: Step into one mirror and out of another up to twelve blocks ahead, walls or not.
ability.grandline.mirror_shards.desc: Shatter a mirror and fling the shards in a fan.
ability.grandline.mirror_dazzle.desc: Flash sunlight off a mirror into the eyes of everyone in front of you.
ability.grandline.mirror_hall.desc: Surround yourself with a hall of mirrors: foes inside are lost and dizzy, and every projectile is thrown back.
ability.grandline.mirror_glass_rain.desc: Shatter a sky full of mirrors over the spot you point at: a rain of glass shreds everyone below.
ability.grandline.pop_shrapnel.desc: Swell a scrap of metal in your hand and hurl it: it bursts into shrapnel where it lands.
ability.grandline.pop_rupture.desc: Lay a hand on a foe's armour and make it swell and burst: a blast right against its body.
ability.grandline.pop_swell_guard.desc: Puff your body up into a tough, bulging shell.
ability.grandline.pop_burst_field.desc: Swell the ground itself where you point: a moment later the lumps burst under everyone standing there.
ability.grandline.pop_mass_rupture.desc: Every bit of metal on every foe around you swells and bursts at once.
ability.grandline.pop_shard_storm.desc: Burst a mass of metal high overhead: a storm of shrapnel rains on the spot you point at.
ability.grandline.soul_soul_pocus.desc: Ask "life or treats?": everyone in front of you weaker than you has years of lifespan torn out (a share of their health, and some of it is yours); the stronger merely falter.
ability.grandline.soul_prometheus.desc: Give a soul to the sun: Prometheus hovers at your shoulder and burns everything that comes near you.
ability.grandline.soul_zeus.desc: Your thundercloud homie Zeus strikes the foe you point at with a bolt of lightning.
ability.grandline.soul_napoleon.desc: Napoleon, your living sword, cleaves through everything in a wide arc in front of you.
ability.grandline.soul_homies.desc: Breathe soul into the things around you: two flying homies dart out to fight for you for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.soul_heavenly_fire.des: Hurl a spear of living fire that explodes where it lands, setting everything around ablaze.
ability.grandline.swim_ground_swim.desc: Slip beneath the ground and swim: hidden, fast and hard to hurt, though you can't strike from down there.
ability.grandline.swim_surface.desc: Surge up out of the ground right under the foe you point at, uppercutting it into the air.
ability.grandline.swim_dive_bomb.desc: Leap from the ground and dive headfirst back into it at the spot you point at, like a diver into a pool.
ability.grandline.swim_wall_swim.desc: Swim straight through the wall in front of you and come out the other side.
ability.grandline.swim_drag_under.desc: Grab a foe's ankles from below and drag it half into the ground, where it sticks.
ability.grandline.swim_liquid_ground.des: Turn the ground around you liquid: foes wade and sink, getting stuck again and again.
ability.grandline.swim_breach.desc: Burst out of the ground in a long leaping arc, crashing through every foe along the way.
ability.grandline.wring_wring.desc: Grab a foe and wring it like a rag: you drink what drips out and heal, and it is left weak.
ability.grandline.wring_juice_jet.desc: Squeeze out the juice you've collected in a high-pressure jet that bowls over everything in a line.
ability.grandline.wring_swell.desc: Drink down everything you've wrung out and swell into a giant: bigger, harder-hitting, and tougher.
ability.grandline.wring_dry_out.desc: Wring the moisture out of everyone around you: they shrivel, starving and slow, and you drink.
ability.grandline.wring_twist_cut.desc: Wind your arm round like a wrung rag and let it whip loose in a twisting sword cut.
ability.grandline.wring_giant_pour.desc: Pour out a giant's store of wrung juice in a crushing torrent that blasts everything in front of you away.
ability.grandline.barrier_wall.desc: Raise an unbreakable barrier wall in front of you.
ability.grandline.barrier_bulls.desc: Charge behind a barrier held out in front of you, ramming everyone in your path aside.
ability.grandline.barrier_crash.desc: Throw a flat slab of barrier that smashes through a line of foes.
ability.grandline.barrier_ball.desc: Seal yourself in a sphere of barrier: projectiles bounce off and blows barely land.
ability.grandline.barrier_box.desc: Trap a foe in a box of barrier: it is stuck inside for four seconds.
ability.grandline.barrier_crush.desc: Two barrier walls slam together on the spot you point at, crushing everything between.
ability.grandline.barrier_dome.desc: Throw an unbreakable dome over yourself and everyone near you for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.memory_cut_scene.desc: Snip the fight out of the memory of every beast around you: they all forget you for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.memory_cut.desc: Cut the memory of strength out of a foe: every boost it has is gone, a fighter forgets the technique it was using, and the shock of the cut hurts.
ability.grandline.mirror_mirro_world.des: Pull a foe through a mirror into the world behind the glass: gone for four seconds.
ability.grandline.pop_punk_pistol.desc: Swell your fist as it lands so it bursts against whatever it hits.
ability.grandline.soul_maser.desc: Prometheus and Zeus fire together: a beam of fire and lightning burns through everything ahead.
ability.grandline.wring_desert.desc: Wring the whole battlefield dry: everyone around you is drained at once, and every drop heals you.
ability.grandline.age_distorted_future.d: Reach into a possible future and become it: bigger, stronger, tougher and faster.
ability.grandline.age_second_childhood.d: Wind your own age back: you are small, quick and fresh for fifteen seconds, and the years' aches are gone.
ability.grandline.age_wither_touch.desc: Age whatever you touch to dust: a terrible wound that keeps withering.
ability.grandline.age_aging_wave.desc: Sweep a wave of years over everything in front of you: they age, wither and slow to a crawl.
ability.grandline.brain_analyze.desc: Study a foe: read its health and armour, light it up, and mark its weak points for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.brain_laser_pistol.des: Fire a pocket laser: a beam that burns through everything in a line.
ability.grandline.brain_drones.desc: Launch three combat drones that hunt your foes for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.brain_energy_shield.de: Switch on a personal energy shield: much tougher armour while it holds.
ability.grandline.brain_overclock.desc: Hold to overclock your laser, release to fire: the longer the charge, the hotter and further it burns.
ability.grandline.brain_punk_records.des: Tap Punk Records, the shared library of every mind: for thirty seconds you see every creature around you through walls and know all their weak points.
ability.grandline.brain_mother_flame.des: Fire Mother Flame, the sun in a bottle: a colossal beam that burns everything in a long line.
ability.grandline.castle_cannon_volley.d: Open the gun ports in your body and fire a spread of three cannonballs.
ability.grandline.castle_garrison.desc: Let your garrison march out: three musket soldiers fight for you for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.castle_fortress_body.d: Harden into a fortress: much tougher and immovable, but slower.
ability.grandline.castle_rampart.desc: Raise castle ramparts in a ring around you for twelve seconds.
ability.grandline.castle_siege_cannon.de: Fire the great siege cannon: one huge shell that blasts a wide area.
ability.grandline.castle_bombardment.des: Call down a bombardment from every gun in the castle on the spot you point at, for five seconds.
ability.grandline.castle_big_father.desc: Become Big Father: a walking castle twice your size, heavily armoured, whose cannons fire on the nearest foe every second and a half.
ability.grandline.clothes_instant_outfit: Dress yourself and every friend beside you in a tough outfit in an instant: extra armour for thirty seconds.
ability.grandline.clothes_costume.desc: Sew yourself a costume of the creature you're looking at (a zombie if nothing): its kind won't attack you until you strike one of them.
ability.grandline.clothes_unstitch.desc: Unpick a foe's clothes and armour at the seams: its armour counts for far less for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.clothes_wrap_up.desc: Wrap a foe head to foot in a bolt of cloth: it can't move or act for three and a half seconds.
ability.grandline.clothes_cloth_glider.d: Spread a cloak into a wide glider: fall slowly, drift forward, and land softly.
ability.grandline.clothes_full_regalia.d: Dress yourself and all your friends in full regalia: heavy armour and quicker feet for a minute.
Unroll a great bolt of cloth around you: every foe nearby is wrapped up tight for three seconds.
ability.grandline.gravity_press.desc: Crush the spot you point at under heavy gravity: everything there is slammed down and pinned.
ability.grandline.gravity_levitate.desc: Lift yourself on your own gravity and fly.
ability.grandline.gravity_uplift.desc: Reverse gravity around you: every foe nearby is flung up into the air, to come crashing down.
ability.grandline.gravity_meteor.desc: Pull a meteor down from space onto the spot you point at.
ability.grandline.gravity_heavy_field.de: Lay crushing gravity over the land around you for ten seconds: every foe inside is pinned flat and ground down.
ability.grandline.heat_boiling_point.des: Raise a foe's body to boiling point from afar: it burns, weakens and slows.
ability.grandline.heat_steam_burst.desc: Flash-boil the moisture around you into a scalding blast of steam that blinds and throws foes back.
ability.grandline.heat_searing_charge.de: Charge forward with searing fists: everything in your path is burned and bowled aside.
ability.grandline.heat_boiling_sea.desc: Heat the ground around you until it boils: for ten seconds, everything standing in it scalds and slows.
ability.grandline.magnet_repel.desc: Push everything in front of you away with a magnetic wave: foes are flung, and arrows and shots turn back.
ability.grandline.magnet_attract.desc: Magnetise everything around you and pull it in: foes are dragged to your feet, loose items fly to you.
ability.grandline.magnet_scrap_arm.desc: Pull scrap metal onto your arm into a massive fist: your blows land much harder and reach further.
ability.grandline.magnet_scrap_shot.desc: Fire three chunks of magnetised scrap that tear through everything in their way.
ability.grandline.magnet_damned_punk.des: Charge a magnetic railgun on your arm and fire: a bolt that tears through everything in a long line.
ability.grandline.magnet_punk_rotten.des: Pull every scrap of metal around into a giant body: bigger, armoured and crushing, it drags foes toward you.
ability.grandline.millet_kibi_dango.desc: Toss a millet dumpling: a beast that eats it is your loyal companion for a minute (up to four). Friends heal.
ability.grandline.millet_feast.desc: Share a feast of dumplings: you and every companion heal, and keep healing for a while.
ability.grandline.millet_heel.desc: Whistle your companions to your side: they appear beside you, hardened for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.millet_scatter.desc: Scatter a fan of five dumplings: tame several beasts at once.
ability.grandline.millet_beast_army.desc: Shower dumplings over everything around you: every beast nearby joins you, up to eight, for a minute.
ability.grandline.millet_rally.desc: Rally the pack: every companion is healed and fights stronger, faster and tougher for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.ripe_ripen.desc: Touch a foe and ripen it past its prime: it is hurt, weakened and slowed.
ability.grandline.ripe_rotten_ground.des: Ripen the ground where you point until it rots: anyone standing on it sickens and slows.
ability.grandline.ripe_harvest.desc: Ripen every crop and sapling around you in a moment.
ability.grandline.ripe_rot_armor.desc: Rot a foe's armour on its body: every piece crumbles, and it protects far less for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.ripe_overripe.desc: Ripen a foe until it bursts: a heavy wound, sickness and poison.
ability.grandline.ripe_age_of_decay.desc: Bring an age of decay on everyone around you: their armour crumbles, their strength fades, their bodies wither.
ability.grandline.ripe_rotting_field.des: Spread ripening through the land around you for ten seconds: crops leap up, and every foe inside rots where it stands.
ability.grandline.song_musical_note.desc: Sing a bright note that flies at the nearest foe and strikes it.
