ability.grandline.song_lullaby.desc: Hold to sing a lullaby: foes around you slow, and every two seconds the beasts among them fall asleep.
ability.grandline.song_encore.desc: Sing an encore: you and your friends nearby move faster, hit harder and heal for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.song_ribbon_bind.desc: Lash a foe with ribbons of staff lines: it is bound fast and stung.
ability.grandline.song_fortissimo.desc: Hit the loudest note you can: a wall of sound that blasts everything in front of you away.
ability.grandline.song_uta_world.desc: Pull everyone around you into the world of song for ten seconds: inside, foes are stung and slowed, and every three seconds they drift off to sleep.
ability.grandline.song_tot_musica.desc: Sing the forbidden score and call the demon king of music: a crushing blast of darkness around you.
ability.grandline.sparkle_diamond_fist.d: Punch with a fist of diamond: it hits like a cannonball and throws the foe back.
ability.grandline.sparkle_diamond_body.d: Turn your skin to diamond: far tougher, and hard to knock back.
ability.grandline.sparkle_brilliant_punk: Charge in shoulder-first, diamond-hard, and crash through the first foe in your way.
Hold to brace in solid diamond: almost no damage gets through, and anyone who strikes you bruises their hands.
ability.grandline.sparkle_diamond_shards: Flick a spray of razor-sharp diamond shards that cut through everything in their path.
Tear out a boulder of diamond and hurl it: it lands like a meteor and scatters everything around.
ability.grandline.sparkle_prism_flash.de: Catch the light in your diamond body and flash it out: everyone around is blinded and seared.
ability.grandline.time_send_ahead.desc: Send a foe three seconds into the future: it vanishes from the fight, and nothing can reach it or it them.
ability.grandline.time_accelerate.desc: Hurry your own time along: you move and strike much faster.
ability.grandline.time_slow_moment.desc: Make time crawl where you point: for eight seconds, everything inside moves at a snail's pace.
ability.grandline.time_years_later.desc: Send everyone around you years ahead: every foe nearby vanishes from the fight for four seconds.
ability.grandline.time_ahead_of_the_blow: For ten seconds, leap a moment ahead of every blow: attacks that would hit you land on nothing.
ability.grandline.warp_sky_drop.desc: Warp a foe high into the air above where it stands, and let it fall.
ability.grandline.warp_swap.desc: Swap places with a creature you can see.
ability.grandline.warp_mass_drop.desc: Warp every foe around you high into the sky at once.
ability.grandline.age_up.desc: Age a foe decades in a moment: it is hurt, and slow, weak and frail for eight seconds.
ability.grandline.age_down.desc: Turn a foe back into a child for ten seconds: half its size and half its strength.
ability.grandline.age_reversal.desc: Wind back the clocks of you and every friend nearby: wounds close and every ailment is undone.
ability.grandline.gold_spears.desc: Raise a line of golden spears from the ground toward where you look.
ability.grandline.gold_coat.desc: Coat yourself in a shell of gold: heavy, hard armour.
ability.grandline.gold_shackle.desc: Lock a foe in a shell of gold: it can't move or act for three and a half seconds.
ability.grandline.gold_fist.desc: A giant golden fist bursts from the ground beneath a foe and hurls it skyward.
ability.grandline.gold_wall.desc: Raise a wall of solid gold in front of you.
ability.grandline.gold_dragon.desc: Raise a great golden dragon and send it roaring through everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.gold_prison.desc: Close every foe around you in a prison of gold: none can move or act for four seconds.
ability.grandline.gravity_blade.desc: Draw and cut: the slash carries gravity with it and presses everything it hits into the ground.
ability.grandline.gravity_well.desc: Open a gravity well where you point: for six seconds it drags everything around into its crushing centre.
ability.grandline.heat_palm.desc: Strike with a red-hot palm: it burns, and it boils anything standing in water.
ability.grandline.heat_aura.desc: Glow red-hot: anything that stands near you burns, and you can't be set alight.
ability.grandline.heat_wave.desc: Release a wave of searing heat that sweeps the land in front of you, setting everything ablaze.
ability.grandline.magnet_slam.desc: Magnetise a foe and drag it into the ground: it is crushed and pinned.
ability.grandline.millet_sic_em.desc: Point at a foe: every companion charges it, fired up and stronger for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.time_leap.desc: Hold to step out of the present: unseen, untouchable and unmoving, for up to three seconds.
ability.grandline.time_fast_forward.desc: Fast-forward a foe through time: every effect on it runs out at once, the young grow up, and the years hurt.
ability.grandline.warp_step.desc: Warp to the spot you're looking at, up to sixteen blocks away.
ability.grandline.warp_bullet.desc: Fire a bullet that warps straight into a target you can see, however far: no travel, no dodging.
ability.grandline.warp_anchor.desc: Drop a warp anchor where you stand: when the move ends, up to thirty seconds later, you warp back to it.
ability.grandline.warp_barrage.desc: Empty your rifle through warp holes: a bullet lands in each of the six nearest foes in the same instant.
ability.grandline.big_giant_stomp.desc: Stomp the ground: everything around you is crushed and bounced into the air.
ability.grandline.big_grow.desc: Grow to a giant's size: far bigger, longer-reaching, harder-hitting and tougher, though a little slower.
ability.grandline.big_giant_sweep.desc: Sweep your huge arm across the ground in front of you, batting everything away.
ability.grandline.big_boulder_toss.desc: Rip up a boulder and hurl it: it bursts on whatever it hits.
ability.grandline.big_quake_step.desc: Bring your foot down so hard the ground splits ahead of you: everything along the crack is crushed and slowed.
ability.grandline.big_colossus.desc: Grow into a colossus: five times your size, immensely strong, and trampling every foe at your feet.
ability.grandline.big_giant_charge.desc: Charge like a stampeding giant: everything in your path is flattened and flung aside.
ability.grandline.brush_ink_slash.desc: Paint a blade in one stroke and cut with it before the ink dries.
ability.grandline.brush_painted_wolves.d: Paint two wolves that leap off the page and hunt for you for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.brush_ink_crane.desc: Paint a crane and ride it: you are carried up and forward, then drift gently down.
ability.grandline.brush_painted_flames.d: Paint a wall of flames in front of you: they burn as hot as real ones.
ability.grandline.brush_ink_serpent.desc: Paint an ink serpent that slithers after the nearest foe and bites through everything in its way.
ability.grandline.brush_orochi.desc: Paint your masterpiece, a great serpent beast, and set it loose on your foes for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.brush_ink_storm.desc: Fling ink across the sky over the spot you point at: a black rain that blinds and burns for six seconds.
ability.grandline.genie_lamp_smoke.desc: Pour the genie out as a choking cloud of lamp smoke around you: foes inside are blinded and pummelled.
ability.grandline.guzzle_guzzle.desc: Take a long guzzle: you heal, shrug off fire, hit harder, and your flames burn far hotter for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.guzzle_fire_breath.des: Hold to breathe a stream of fire over everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.guzzle_booze_bomb.desc: Spit a ball of flaming liquor that bursts into fire on whatever it hits.
ability.grandline.guzzle_flaming_belch.d: Let out a flaming belch: a ring of fire bursts out around you and throws foes back.
ability.grandline.guzzle_drunken_brawl.d: Fight like a drunk: wild, heavy blows, and you sway out of the way of one hit in four.
Breathe out every drop at once: a roaring inferno that engulfs everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.guzzle_sea_of_booze.de: Spill a sea of burning liquor around you: for ten seconds, everything standing in it burns.
ability.grandline.island_land_fist.desc: A fist of earth bursts from the ground under a foe and hurls it upward.
ability.grandline.island_earth_wall.desc: Raise a wall of packed earth in front of you.
ability.grandline.island_land_grab.desc: The ground opens and closes around a foe's legs: it is stuck fast and crushed.
ability.grandline.island_terrain_heave.d: Heave the land around you: every foe nearby is thrown into the air and battered by the rising ground.
ability.grandline.island_living_island.d: Wake the island around you for fifteen seconds: fists of earth keep bursting up under every foe on it.
ability.grandline.luck_lucky_strike.desc: Strike, and let luck guide the blow: with luck banked, it often lands for double.
ability.grandline.luck_lucky_dodge.desc: Trust your luck: while this lasts, attacks often just miss you, and more often the more luck you've banked.
ability.grandline.luck_jackpot.desc: Cash in every luck you've banked: heal for each, and fight stronger and faster for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.luck_misfortune.desc: Curse a foe with misfortune: bad luck, and two ailments the dice choose.
ability.grandline.luck_lucky_streak.desc: Ride a lucky streak: your luck is full, the world's luck favours you, and you move quicker for thirty seconds.
ability.grandline.pass_intangible.desc: Hold to let everything pass through you: blows and shots go straight through, though you can barely move.
ability.grandline.pass_sink_through.desc: Sink through the floor and drop into the open space beneath it.
ability.grandline.pass_half_sink.desc: Push a foe halfway into the floor: it is stuck to the waist and squeezed.
ability.grandline.pass_phantom.desc: Become a phantom for ten seconds: unseen, and every attack passes straight through you.
ability.grandline.push_clay_push.desc: Shove the ground forward in a surge that bowls over everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.push_knead_down.desc: Knead the ground under a foe soft as clay: it sinks to the knees and is stuck.
ability.grandline.push_earth_surf.desc: Push the ground beneath you into a rolling wave and ride it forward, bowling over everything in the way.
ability.grandline.push_clay_pillar.desc: Squeeze the ground under a foe so it shoots up as a pillar of clay and launches it skyward.
ability.grandline.push_earth_wave.desc: Send a wave of rolling earth across the ground: it throws everything in its path into the air.
ability.grandline.push_clay_fortress.des: Push the ground up into a ring of thick clay walls around you for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.push_landslide.desc: Push the whole hillside forward: a landslide that crushes and buries everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.return_rewind.desc: Return yourself five seconds: back where you stood then, and at least as healthy as you were.
ability.grandline.return_twelve_years.de: Touch a foe and send twelve years of it back: smaller and far weaker for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.return_mend.desc: Return the bodies of you and everyone beside you to before they were hurt: wounds close and ailments vanish.
ability.grandline.return_unmake.desc: Return a foe's strength to before it had any: every boost on it is gone, and the shock hurts.
ability.grandline.return_rewind_field.de: Open a field where time runs backward for ten seconds: friends inside heal and shed ailments, foes are held back.
ability.grandline.return_full_return.des: Return yourself ten seconds, wounds and ailments and all, and pull every friend beside you back from their injuries too.
ability.grandline.return_regression_wave: Sweep twelve years off everything in front of you: foes shrink, weaken and stagger.
ability.grandline.sprout_vine_whip.desc: Lash out with a whip of fast-growing vine: it strikes a foe and drags it to you.
ability.grandline.sprout_bramble_bind.de: Brambles burst up around a foe's legs: it is held fast and pricked by thorns.
ability.grandline.sprout_bloom.desc: Make everything around you bloom: crops and saplings leap up, and you are refreshed.
ability.grandline.sprout_tree_spear.desc: A tree trunk spears up out of the ground beneath a foe and hurls it into the air.
ability.grandline.sprout_thicket.desc: Grow a dense thicket in a ring around you: a living wall for twelve seconds.
ability.grandline.sprout_forest_surge.de: Flood the land around you with wild growth for ten seconds: roots keep seizing and battering every foe.
ability.grandline.sprout_beanstalk.desc: A beanstalk erupts beneath you: you shoot up into the sky and float down, and foes beside you are flung away.
ability.grandline.straw_tarot.desc: Draw a tarot card and take what it says: the Sun (strength and speed), Temperance (healing), the Tower (an explosion that hits every foe around you) or Death (every foe nearby withers).
ability.grandline.straw_scarecrow_army.d: Raise four straw scarecrows with bows that fight for you for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.tone_scratch.desc: Strum the air: the note cuts a foe you can see the instant it's heard.
ability.grandline.tone_chest_drum.desc: Beat your chest like a drum: the boom throws back everyone around you.
ability.grandline.tone_horn_blast.desc: Blow a horn from your arm: the blast staggers and dizzies everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.tone_march_rhythm.desc: Play a marching rhythm: you and your friends nearby move and work faster for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.tone_concert.desc: Turn the ground around you into a stage for ten seconds: every foe on it is shocked and dizzied by the music.
ability.grandline.tone_grand_finale.desc: Play every instrument at once: a deafening wall of sound that tears through everything ahead.
ability.grandline.butter_shot.desc: Fling a lump of butter: it smacks, sticks, and leaves the target slow and clumsy.
ability.grandline.butter_slick.desc: Spread slippery butter where you point: nobody can keep their footing on it for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.butter_glue.desc: Harden butter into glue around a foe's legs: it is stuck where it stands for four seconds.
ability.grandline.butter_coat.desc: Coat yourself in slippery butter: blows slide off you and do half the harm.
ability.grandline.butter_spear.desc: Harden butter into a spear and hurl it: it runs through everything in its way.
ability.grandline.butter_flood.desc: Pour out a rolling flood of melted butter: everything in front of you is swept off its feet and left sliding.
ability.grandline.butter_cast.desc: Set every foe around you in a hard cast of butter: none can move or act for three and a half seconds.
ability.grandline.genie_punch.desc: The genie throws a long punch over your shoulder that knocks down everything in a line.
ability.grandline.genie_spear.desc: The genie hurls its spear: it runs through everything in its path.
ability.grandline.genie_guard.desc: The genie wraps its arms around you: much tougher and hard to knock back.
ability.grandline.genie_slam.desc: The genie brings both fists down on the spot you point at, flattening and throwing everything there.
ability.grandline.genie_grab.desc: The genie snatches a foe and drags it to you, holding it fast for a moment.
ability.grandline.genie_fury.desc: The genie flies into a fury: one crushing blow lands on each of the six nearest foes.
ability.grandline.island_body.desc: Become one with the land: very tough, immovable, and slowly healing while you stand on the ground.
ability.grandline.island_crush.desc: Bring a mountain of earth down on the spot you point at: everything there is crushed and buried.
ability.grandline.luck_steal.desc: Touch foes and steal their luck: they are cursed with bad luck, and you bank one luck for each.
ability.grandline.luck_all_in.desc: Go all in: every banked luck is spent on one blast around you, harder for each, and every hit may crit.
ability.grandline.pass_through.desc: Walk straight through the wall in front of you, however thick (up to eight blocks).
ability.grandline.pass_strike.desc: Reach through a foe's armour and strike the body beneath: armour does nothing against it.
ability.grandline.pass_through_and_throu: Rush straight through everything ahead, foes and walls alike: those you pass through are struck from inside.
ability.grandline.straw_needles.desc: Shoot a spray of hardened straw needles that run through everything in their path.
ability.grandline.straw_effigy.desc: Bind a foe to a straw effigy for thirty seconds: half of every wound you take lands on them instead.
ability.grandline.straw_man.desc: Swell into a straw man: bigger, tougher and harder-hitting.
ability.grandline.straw_sword.desc: Draw a sword of woven straw from your arm and cut in a wide arc.
ability.grandline.straw_demon.desc: Become a demon of straw: huge, armoured and savage.
ability.grandline.tone_bomb.desc: Pluck a note that lands on a foe and explodes there, hurting everything around it.
ability.grandline.albatross_hybrid.desc: Grow great white wings: you can fly, and you are quicker on the ground.
ability.grandline.albatross_beast.desc: Become an albatross: a tireless flier, fast and light.
ability.grandline.albatross_beak_jab.des: Jab with your hooked beak at whatever is in front of you. Needs a form.
Buffet everything in front of you with your great wings, knocking it away. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.albatross_updraft.desc: Catch an updraft: you are lifted high and glide down slowly.
ability.grandline.albatross_headline.des: Spread the headline: every foe within twenty blocks is exposed for fifteen seconds, glowing and shaken.
ability.grandline.albatross_dive_bomb.de: Fold your wings and drop onto the spot you point at: a diving blast that scatters everything there. Needs a form.
Bring a sea storm's winds down where you point: for six seconds they batter and blow back everything inside.
ability.grandline.albatross_feather_voll: Shake loose a volley of quill-hard feathers in a wide fan, twice over.
ability.grandline.anaconda_hybrid.desc: Your legs become a great snake's tail: tougher, stronger, and at home in water.
ability.grandline.anaconda_beast.desc: Become an anaconda: long, heavy, very tough, and a swift swimmer.
ability.grandline.anaconda_constrict.des: Hold to wrap your coils around the nearest foe: it is held fast and squeezed harder every half second. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.anaconda_tail_whip.des: Lash your tail across everything in front of you. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.anaconda_striking_fang: Strike like a snake: a lunging bite on a foe in reach that leaves it bleeding. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.anaconda_coil_guard.de: Coil up tight for five seconds: you take far less harm, and anything that strikes you is squeezed for it.
ability.grandline.anaconda_swallow.desc: Swallow a small foe whole for three seconds: it can do nothing and is digested a little. Big foes and bosses won't fit. Needs the full beast.
ability.grandline.anaconda_crushing_coil: Throw your coils around everything nearby and squeeze: all are held fast and crushed. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.anaconda_serpent_dance: Whirl your whole body around: everything nearby is battered and flung away. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.axolotl_hybrid.desc: Grow gills and a tail: tougher, quick to heal, and at home in water.
ability.grandline.axolotl_beast.desc: Become an axolotl: low and slippery, very tough, a swift swimmer that heals fast.
ability.grandline.axolotl_toxic_breath.d: Hold to breathe out a stream of poison gas over everything in front of you.
ability.grandline.axolotl_regrow.desc: Regrow your wounds: heal at once and keep healing for five seconds.
ability.grandline.axolotl_gas_body.desc: Let your body thin into gas: blows hurt less, and whatever strikes you breathes in poison.
ability.grandline.axolotl_slime_spit.des: Spit a glob of toxic slime that bursts on impact and poisons everything around it.
ability.grandline.axolotl_poison_cloud.d: Leave a drifting cloud of poison gas where you point: for eight seconds it poisons and sickens everything inside.
ability.grandline.axolotl_giant_smiley.d: Swell into a vast grinning cloud of poison around you: for ten seconds everything inside withers in it.
ability.grandline.axolotl_toxic_burst.de: Burst your gas body outward: everything around you is blasted with poison and thrown away.
ability.grandline.bison_hybrid.desc: Grow horns and a bison's bulk: bigger, harder-hitting, armoured and hard to push.
ability.grandline.bison_beast.desc: Become a bison: a heavy, fast charger that can't be knocked back.
ability.grandline.bison_horn_gore.desc: Hook your horns through whatever is in front of you and toss it. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.bison_stampede.desc: Lower your head and charge: everything in your path is gored aside. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.bison_thick_hide.desc: Brace your thick hide: much tougher and immovable for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.bison_ground_paw.desc: Paw the ground and stamp down: everything around you is jolted off its feet. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.bison_bull_rush.desc: A long bull rush: everything you hit is gored, dazed and slowed. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.bison_great_stampede.d: A thundering stampede twenty blocks long: everything in the way is gored, and the ground shakes all along it.
ability.grandline.bison_iron_horns.desc: Horns hard as iron: a toss that breaks armour, sending everything in front of you flying. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.elephant_hybrid.desc: Grow tusks and great ears: bigger, stronger, armoured and hard to push.
ability.grandline.elephant_beast.desc: Become an elephant: huge, very tough, immovable and crushing.
ability.grandline.elephant_trunk_slam.de: Bring your trunk down like a club on everything in front of you, bouncing it into the air. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.elephant_tusk_gore.des: Drive your tusks through whatever is in front of you and toss it. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.elephant_trumpet.desc: Trumpet: the blast of sound shoves back, weakens and slows everything around you.
ability.grandline.elephant_earthshaker.d: Stamp the earth: everything around you is crushed and thrown up by the shock. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.elephant_trunk_toss.de: Wrap your trunk around a foe and hurl it far away. Needs a form.
Blast a torrent of water from your trunk: it batters everything in a long line, puts out fires and blows foes away.
ability.grandline.elephant_herd_stampede: Charge like a whole herd: everything in your path is gored aside, and the ground shakes behind you. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.falcon_hybrid.desc: Grow great wings and talons: you can fly, and you strike harder.
ability.grandline.falcon_beast.desc: Become a great falcon: fast in the air and hard to bring down from a fall.
ability.grandline.falcon_talon_dive.desc: Dive on a foe talons first: it is torn and left bleeding. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.falcon_wing_gust.desc: Beat your wings at everything in front of you: a gust that batters and blows it away.
Loose a flurry of steel-hard feathers that cut through everything in their path. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.falcon_sky_lift.desc: Seize the nearest foe in your talons and climb: you both shoot skyward, and it falls when you let go.
ability.grandline.falcon_royal_dive.desc: Drop out of the sky onto the spot you point at: a royal dive that blasts everything there.
ability.grandline.giraffe_hybrid.desc: Grow ossicones, a giraffe's hide and a long reach: harder-hitting and a little bigger.
ability.grandline.giraffe_beast.desc: Become a towering giraffe: tall, fast, and able to step over walls.
ability.grandline.giraffe_neck_whip.desc: Swing your long neck like a club through everything in front of you, sweeping it aside. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.giraffe_blade_kick.des: A giraffe's kick, sharp as a blade: it hits hard and throws the foe back. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.giraffe_lookout.desc: Look out over everything: creatures within forty blocks stand out for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.giraffe_storm_leg.desc: Kick so fast the air cuts: a blade of wind flies out and runs through everything in its path.
ability.grandline.giraffe_bishop_neck.de: Ram your head down on a foe from above: a crushing blow that leaves it dazed. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.giraffe_neck_cannon.de: Fire your whole neck forward like a cannon: everything in a long line is blasted away. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.giraffe_storm_cross.de: Two crossing blades of wind from a pair of kicks, each running through everything in its way.
ability.grandline.horse_hybrid.desc: Grow a horse's ears, mane and legs: quick on your feet, a high jumper and a hard kicker.
ability.grandline.horse_beast.desc: Become a horse: a very fast galloper that jumps high and steps over obstacles.
ability.grandline.horse_hoof_kick.desc: Kick with your hooves: whatever is in front of you is thrown well away. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.horse_gallop.desc: Break into a gallop: much faster for ten seconds.
ability.grandline.horse_rear_up.desc: Rear up and slam your forehooves down: everything around you is crushed and bounced. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.horse_trample.desc: Charge straight through: everything in your path is trampled and knocked aside. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.horse_steed.desc: Lend your speed to your friends: everyone beside you runs and jumps like a horse for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.horse_pegasus_wings.de: Grow a pegasus's wings: fly for thirty seconds.
ability.grandline.horse_thunder_hooves.d: Bring all four hooves down like thunder: a shockwave crushes and throws everything around you. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.human_hybrid.desc: Bulk up into Heavy Point: half again your size, much stronger and tougher.
ability.grandline.human_beast.desc: Become the Monster Point: a towering, shaggy giant with antlers, immensely strong but slow.
ability.grandline.human_hoof_punch.desc: A hoof-fisted punch that knocks a foe flying. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.human_guard_point.desc: Hold to puff up into a ball of fur: blows barely hurt and can't push you around, but you can hardly move.
ability.grandline.human_antler_charge.de: Lower your antlers and charge: everything in your path is gored aside. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.human_scope.desc: Study a foe through your scope: it glows, and every blow you land on it for fifteen seconds hits half again as hard.
ability.grandline.human_rumble_ball.desc: Swallow a Rumble Ball: you heal and fight stronger and faster for thirty seconds.
ability.grandline.human_rampage.desc: Rampage as the Monster: a crushing blow on everything around you. Needs the Monster Point.
ability.grandline.jackal_hybrid.desc: Grow a jackal's head, ears and jaws: quicker, tougher and harder-biting.
ability.grandline.jackal_beast.desc: Become a jackal: very fast on four legs and light on its feet.
ability.grandline.jackal_pack_call.desc: Howl for the pack: two jackals come running to hunt with you for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.jackal_lunge.desc: Lunge at a foe in sight, closing the gap in an instant and biting on arrival. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.jackal_jaw_lock.desc: Bite down and hold: the foe is pinned in your jaws and bleeds heavily. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.jackal_anubis_jaws.des: The jaws of the god of the dead: a great bite in front of you that tears, bleeds and withers. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.jackal_desert_pack.des: Call the desert pack: four strong jackals hunt with you for twenty seconds.
ability.grandline.king_cobra_hybrid.desc: Grow a hood and a cobra's tail: stronger and tougher, with venom in your bite.
ability.grandline.king_cobra_beast.desc: Become a king cobra, reared up and hooded: very tough and quick to strike.
Sink venomous fangs into whatever is in front of you. Needs a form.
Spit venom at a foe: it poisons and blinds.
Spread your hood and rear up: foes in front of you lose their nerve, weakened and slowed.
ability.grandline.king_cobra_scorching_h: Heat your hood until it glows and lash it at everything in front of you: they burn.
Coil around a foe and bite deep: it is held fast as venom and decay set in. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.king_cobra_fire_serpen: Loose a serpent of fire from your burning hood: it scorches everything in a long cone.
Pour out a pool of venom around you: for eight seconds, everything standing in it is poisoned and hurt.
ability.grandline.mole_hybrid.desc: Grow digging claws: you dig much faster and hit harder.
ability.grandline.mole_beast.desc: Become a mole: low to the ground, quick, and digs faster still.
ability.grandline.mole_burrow.desc: Dig straight ahead through soft ground (earth, sand, gravel) and come out the other side, up to ten blocks.
ability.grandline.mole_dig_down.desc: Dig straight down through soft ground into the open space below it.
ability.grandline.mole_pit_trap.desc: Hollow out the ground beneath a foe: it drops into a pit and is stuck there for four seconds.
ability.grandline.mole_earthquake.desc: Tunnel in a ring beneath everyone around you and collapse it: they are thrown up and then stuck.
ability.grandline.mole_ambush.desc: Vanish into the earth and come up beneath a foe up to twenty blocks away, smashing it skyward.
ability.grandline.tanuki_hybrid.desc: Grow round ears and a bushy tail: quicker and a little tougher.
ability.grandline.tanuki_beast.desc: Become a tanuki: small and quick on your feet.
ability.grandline.tanuki_belly_drum.desc: Drum on your belly: the boom knocks back and dizzies everything around you.
ability.grandline.tanuki_shapeshift.desc: Shapeshift into a harmless pig: monsters lose interest in you while the shape holds, until you strike one.
ability.grandline.tanuki_tail_slam.desc: Swing your thick tail around into whatever is beside you, bouncing it away. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.tanuki_belly_bounce.de: Bounce on your round belly: you spring high, and foes beside you are tossed into the air.
ability.grandline.tanuki_leaf_shuriken.d: Flick a fan of leaves as sharp as blades: they cut through everything in their path.
Swell to the size of a hill: enormous, armoured and immovable, though slow.
Conjure a parade of phantom foxes from leaves: four of them harry your foes for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.wolf_hybrid.desc: Grow a wolf's head, claws and fangs: quicker, tougher and much harder-hitting.
ability.grandline.wolf_beast.desc: Become a grey wolf: very fast on four legs and a strong jumper.
ability.grandline.wolf_pounce.desc: Leap at your prey; the first foe you land on is mauled and pinned for a moment. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.wolf_howl.desc: Howl: you and your friends nearby fight harder and faster, and foes around you lose heart.
ability.grandline.wolf_iron_fang.desc: Harden your body like iron and bite through anything in front of you, shrugging off blows for three seconds.
ability.grandline.wolf_lone_wolf.desc: Hold to tear into everything around you in a frenzy of fangs and claws. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.wolf_moon_howl.desc: Howl at the moon: thirty seconds of strength, speed and healing, twice as strong at night.
ability.grandline.falcon_eye.desc: A falcon's eyes: see in the dark, and every creature around you stands out for fifteen seconds.
ability.grandline.falcon_gale.desc: Whip up a whirling gale where you point: for five seconds it batters, blinds and spins everything inside.
ability.grandline.human_doctors_care.des: A doctor's care for you and every friend nearby: wounds close and poison, wither and sickness are cured.
ability.grandline.jackal_fang.desc: Snap your jaws on whatever is in front of you: deep bites that keep bleeding. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.jackal_hunters_nose.de: Catch every scent around you: creatures within thirty blocks stand out for fifteen seconds, and you see in the dark.
ability.grandline.mole_claws.desc: Rake with digging claws. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.mole_pistol.desc: Burst up out of the ground under a nearby foe and uppercut it into the air. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.wolf_fang.desc: Bite and rake whatever is in front of you: the wounds keep bleeding. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.wolf_gale.desc: Kick so fast the air itself cuts: three slicing waves fly out and run through everything in their path.
